claim: Dynamo does not require etcd or NATS for either local development or Kubernetes deployments; those external services are only needed for Slurm or other non-K8s distributed deployments.
stance_target: non-K8s routers can discover workers without heavyweight external coordination services
scope_conditions: ai-dynamo/dynamo repo, as of Sept 2026 / v1.4.2
quoted_support: Local Development: Not required (etcd/NATS). Pass --discovery-backend file. Kubernetes: Not required (etcd/NATS). K8s-native discovery; TCP request plane. For Slurm or other distributed deployments that choose etcd or NATS JetStream-backed modes.

claim: Dynamo exposes two distinct request-routing topologies: a Dynamo-native path where its own integrated Router makes worker-selection decisions with no external gateway, and a Gateway API path where a K8s Gateway API Inference Extension (GAIE) gateway calls the Dynamo Endpoint Picker Plugin (EPP) before forwarding to a worker.
stance_target: architectural pattern for decoupling router logic from gateway/orchestration layer
quoted_support: Dynamo-native Frontend routing: The Dynamo Frontend serves HTTP and the integrated Dynamo Router makes worker-selection decisions. No external gateway is required. ... Gateway API routing with GAIE: A Kubernetes Gateway API Inference Extension gateway calls the Dynamo Endpoint Picker Plugin (EPP) before forwarding to the selected worker's Frontend sidecar in --router-mode direct.

claim: Dynamo can be started with a file-based discovery backend that requires neither Kubernetes nor an external coordination service, via '--discovery-backend file'.
stance_target: simple non-K8s worker discovery mechanisms exist in production inference routers

claim: Dynamo claims 2x faster time to first token via KV-aware routing on Qwen3-Coder 480B, per an external Baseten benchmark blog, not Dynamo's own controlled benchmark.
stance_target: third-party validated benchmark claims for Dynamo's KV-aware routing
scope_conditions: Baseten production benchmark, cited in Dynamo README
quoted_support: 2x faster time to first token | KV-aware routing, Qwen3-Coder 480B (Baseten benchmark)
